description: Analyze a Dockerfile's layers: parse its instructions, rank layer sizes biggest first when sizes are supplied, and flag wasted layers with deterministic checks (consecutive RUNs, broad copies before the install step, leftover apt lists, ADD used for local files).

layer_sizes.description: Size in bytes of each layer-producing instruction (RUN, COPY, ADD), in Dockerfile order, as docker history would report them; length must equal the number of layer-producing instructions

name: analyze_dockerfile_layers
